scope: Prepare-only instrumented synthetic traces. Timed official kernel is the incumbent. Metadata is exact for each fixture; clocks can be perturbed by instrumentation and are not proof of causal hardware stalls.
timing_attribution_limit: Passing the coarse perturbation gate does not make instrumented timings exact parent timings or prove a particular stall cause. Only two individual full traces; M128 has performance controls but no full CTA trace.
